description: Preserve progressive provenance while making SpecSync warnings blocking inside the unified Trust lifecycle lane
no_spec_change_rationale: This corrects Trust and Fledge governance only; canonical Corvid Hex behavior, requirements, source, tests, dependencies, and public interfaces remain unchanged.
